title: 第十二章  突破聚灵境，进入渊灵之域
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

叶落二人回到学校，已经很晚了，但学校里灯火通明，显然刚刚那件事情远远没有想的那么简单，但叶落也没有多想，毕竟就他目前的修为而言，没有必要去想这些事，抓紧时间提高自己的修为才是最正确的做法。

叶落回到自己的修炼室，丹田运转起了人皇诀，修炼室周围的灵力再次沸腾起来，外部的灵力不断被叶落吸收入丹田，通过丹田的转化，化为金色的灵力，奔腾在经脉之中，流入九大灵窍，整具身体仿佛一个无底洞，炼体九重的灵力转化一周，竟然比之御灵境界的修者也多了不少。同时叶落的身体里其他几大玄功也开始自主运转起来，也还好沈苍月为他布置的聚灵阵，加之精英班的修炼室确实是灵力浓郁之地，否则根本经不起叶落消耗。

不一会叶落便控制几大玄功落入适合的灵窍中，那一粒长生种直接移到了心脏处，在长生诀的全力运转之下，心之灵窍便得无比充盈，脊椎处的青龙血髓，也是在青龙诀的连接下，联通四肢五脏六腑，天穹诀，斗战神诀也是如此。平常状态下，其余九大灵窍自然封闭，此后，每突破一个大境界，解封一个灵窍，就算如此，也远远超越修炼至尊级功法的同级强者，更不必说其他人了。

就身体素质而言，叶落突破御灵级都是绰绰有余，今天在碰见战略级强者一战时的感触，令他轻易突破了聚灵境界，一身的灵力也终于有了用武之地。身怀那么多绝世玄功，叶落知道自己失去记忆前绝非常人，前几日在图书馆也已经把现在的局势搞清楚了，现在也已经能成功控制自己就算是为了自己也得努力提高实力，更不用说还有班里的同学，虽然他还没来多久，但是同学们都对他还不错，而且他也答应了古老头，自然不会辜负他的一番好意。

第二日，叶落来到了沈苍月办公室，

“什么！你要去渊灵之域，不行，太危险了，我不允许”，“嗯？等等，你达到聚灵境了？”

“是的，昨天晚上突破的”，叶落老老实实地说，

沈苍月倒吸一口气，这是什么小怪物，我看那几位都没他那么妖孽，

“行吧，那我也不拦你，你把这个带着”，沈苍月递给叶落一个银色雕花戒指。

“这是？”叶落已经隐隐约约猜到了什么，但还不敢确定。

”这是一套星级纳米斗铠，里面有十立方米空间，本来是想过几天作为赢得武考的奖励给你，现在既然你要去渊灵域，就给你吧，斗铠的功能你穿上就知道了。“

叶落内心一热，“谢谢月姐。”他自然知道这其实只是沈苍月私人给他的。

这套斗铠其实是沈苍月请木筱筱炼制的，说是星级斗铠，其实只是受限于灵识，掺和了部分域外星辰钢，以及其余全由顶级钛合金锻铸的纳米粒子，其防御其实已经超越了星级斗铠，为此，沈苍月还被木筱筱取笑了一番，说是该天一定要好好认识一下她那个宠成这样的徒弟。

叶落辞别导师之后，往学院的秘境方向走去。

该问的都已经问清楚了，他现在可是迫不及待想要进去那处秘境，探知一下内里的情况了，据说这里面曾经也是异域的领地，而现在被人类攻占了，但里面还是有一些异兽，以及妖兽。

而且该准备的东西，都已经提前准备好了。

面具，衣服，地图等等……

而渊灵之域的进入点位于秘境区的最外围，其实也不能叫渊灵之域，这整个一片才叫渊灵之域，但叶落现在要去的纯粹就是外围中的外围。

而在旁边，还有专门独立的更衣区，据说因为在学院里不允许使用灵力会导致学生战斗力的退化，以至于之前出现了有些学生在域外战场被吓哭的场景，因此，学院专门开辟的这么一片秘境，在里面除了杀人，或故意致残不行，其他都是可以的，所以这也要求学生必须隐藏身份，以防止日后报复。

他同样进去换了衣服，从那几个随机的出口中的一个出来。

看来大学考虑的很周到，好几个入口加好几个出口，换完衣服，不用担心被人发现形迹了。

很快所有人都已经都看不到本来的面目，甚至连男女都分辨不清楚了，看起来俨然是在举办欧美联邦的万圣节一般。

很快，便到了叶落。

“你好，请标记一下你这一次在秘境之内打算使用的名字，在这里做一下备录。”

“小草！”

叶落使用特地购买的变声器，满是沙哑的回答道，虽然他也不怕被别人报复，但终究还是守一下规矩。

Page (1/3)

It was already very late when Ye Luo and his two returned to school, but the school was brightly lit. Obviously, what happened just now was far from being as simple as they thought, but Ye Luo didn't think too much about it. After all, with his current cultivation level, there was no need to think about these things. The most correct thing to do was to seize the time to improve his cultivation level.

Ye Luo returned to his training room, and his Dantian activated the Human Emperor Art. The spiritual power around the training room boiled again. The external spiritual power was continuously absorbed into the Dantian by Ye Luo. Through the transformation of the Dantian, it turned into golden spiritual power. It rushed through the meridians and flowed into the nine spiritual orifices. The whole body was like a bottomless pit. The spiritual power of the ninth level of body training was transformed in one week, and it was much more than the cultivators in the realm of controlling spirits.At the same time, several other major mystical skills in Ye Luo's body also began to operate independently. Fortunately, Shen Cangyue arranged the spirit gathering array for him, and the elite class's training room was indeed a place rich in spiritual power, otherwise it would not have been able to withstand Ye Luo's consumption.

After a while, Ye Luo controlled several major mystical arts to fall into the suitable spiritual orifice. The immortality seed was moved directly to the heart. Under the full operation of the Immortality Art, the spiritual orifice of the heart was extremely filled. The Qinglong Blood Marrow in the spine was also connected to the limbs and internal organs by the Qinglong Art. The same was true for the Heavenly Vault Art and the Fighting God Art.Under normal conditions, the remaining nine spiritual orifices are naturally sealed. After that, every time a great realm is broken through, one spiritual orifice is unsealed. Even so, it is far beyond the same level of strong people who practice supreme level skills, let alone others.

As far as physical fitness is concerned, Ye Luo is more than enough to break through the spirit-controlling level. Today's experience when he met a strategic-level strongman made him easily break through the spirit-gathering level, and his spiritual power finally had a use.Possessing so many peerless mystical skills, Ye Luo knew that he was no ordinary person before he lost his memory. He had already figured out the current situation in the library a few days ago and was now able to successfully control himself. Even for his own sake, he had to work hard to improve his strength, not to mention the classmates in the class. Although he had not been here for a long time, the classmates were all pretty good to him, and he also promised Gutou, so he would naturally not let down his kindness.

The next day, Ye Luo came to Shen Cangyue's office.

"What! You want to go to the Yuanling Realm, no, it's too dangerous, I won't allow it." "Huh? Wait, have you reached the Spirit Gathering Realm?"

"Yes, I made a breakthrough last night," Ye Luo said honestly,

Shen Cangyue took a breath, what kind of little monster is this? I don't think those others are as evil as him.

"Okay, I won't stop you, just take this with you." Shen Cangyue handed Ye Luo a silver carved ring.

"This is?" Ye Luo has vaguely guessed something, but is not sure yet.

"This is a set of star-rated nano battle armor with ten cubic meters of space inside. I originally wanted to give it to you in a few days as a reward for winning the martial arts test. Now that you are going to the Yuanling Realm, I will give it to you. You will know the function of the battle armor when you put it on."

Ye Luo felt hot in his heart, "Thank you, Sister Yue." He naturally knew that this was actually given to him personally by Shen Cangyue.

This set of battle armor was actually made by Shen Cangyue at the request of Mu Xiaoxiao. It was said to be a star battle armor, but it was actually limited by spiritual consciousness. It was mixed with some extraterrestrial star steel and the rest of the nanoparticles forged from top-grade titanium alloys. Its defense actually surpassed that of a star battle armor. For this reason, Shen Cangyue was teased by Mu Xiaoxiao, saying that she must get to know her doting apprentice that day.

After Ye Luo said goodbye to his mentor, he walked towards the secret realm of the academy.

All the questions that need to be asked have been asked clearly, and now he can't wait to enter the secret realm and find out what's going on inside. It is said that this place used to be a foreign territory, but now it has been occupied by humans, but there are still some strange beasts and monsters inside.

And everything that needs to be prepared has been prepared in advance.

Masks, clothes, maps, etc…

The entry point to the Yuanling Realm is located at the outermost edge of the secret area. In fact, it cannot be called the Yuanling Realm. This entire area is called the Yuanling Realm. But what Ye Luo wants to go to now is purely the periphery of the periphery.

Next to it, there is a special and independent dressing area. It is said that not allowing the use of spiritual power in the academy will lead to the degradation of students' combat effectiveness, so that some students have been scared to cry on battlefields outside the territory. Therefore, the academy has specially opened up such a secret realm, except for killing people or intentionally maiming. Everything else is allowed, so this also requires students to hide their identities to prevent future revenge.

He also went in, changed his clothes, and came out from one of the random exits.

It seems that the university has thought very carefully. There are several entrances and exits. After changing clothes, you don’t have to worry about being discovered.

Soon everyone could no longer see their true colors, and even men and women could not be distinguished clearly. It looked as if a European and American federal Halloween was being held.

Soon, we arrived at Yeluo.

"Hello, please mark the name you plan to use in the secret realm this time and make a note here."

"Little grass!"

Ye Luo used a specially purchased voice changer and replied hoarsely. Although he was not afraid of being retaliated by others, he still had to abide by the rules after all.
